seo.title: Telluride ski resort guide
seo.description: 149 trails served by 17 lifts above a Victorian town in a box canyon, with a free gondola to Mountain Village.

h1: Telluride ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Telluride sits at the closed end of a box canyon in the San Juan Mountains, with 149 trails served by 17 lifts above it. A free gondola links the Victorian town to Mountain Village at mid-mountain, and Black Iron Bowl holds well over 200 acres of hike-to terrain on the north face.
stayOverview: Two places to stay, joined by a gondola that is free and runs into the evening: the old town at the canyon floor, and Mountain Village up at the lifts.
hotelIntro: Book against high season and pick the end you want - the town for restaurants and the street grid, Mountain Village for walking to the first lift.
rentalCars: Telluride has a regional airport, and the free gondola means a car is not needed between the town and the slopes.

travelTips.title: The gondola is free
travelTips.text: Telluride's gondola between the town and Mountain Village carries skiers and pedestrians at no charge.

travelTips.title: 149 trails
travelTips.text: Served by 17 lifts, per the resort's own snow report.

travelTips.title: Black Iron Bowl
travelTips.text: Well over 200 acres and almost 2,000 vertical feet of hike-to terrain on the north face.

highlights.title: Black Iron Bowl
highlights.text: Well over 200 acres and almost 2,000 vertical feet on the north face, reached on foot from the lifts.

highlights.title: The box canyon
highlights.text: The town sits at the closed end of the canyon, with the mountain rising directly from the street grid.

highlights.title: The free gondola
highlights.text: Links the town to Mountain Village without a ticket.
